title: core/group_log: verify_entry ignores _entry_id parameter
description: crates/core/src/group_log/verify.rs verify_entry() receives _entry_id: &LogEntryId but never uses it. It should compute LogEntryId::from_entry(entry) and verify it matches the provided entry_id — otherwise callers get a false sense of security: the entry contents are verified but the entry_id itself is not checked against the hash of the entry.
